text: ὁ ὑπερβρέφος βάλλει τὸν μικρὸν λίθον εἰς τὸν Λύκον.
objects: a bright red leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
a white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
a small gray stone that fits in one hand
a large gray boulder twice the size of Hyperbrephos
artist_notes: Show the small rock stuck to or bouncing off Lukos's face with impact lines radiating outward. Lukos should have a classic cartoon 'bonk' expression with crossed eyes and his tongue hanging out slightly.
positioning: Hyperbrephos stands in a throwing position with his arm extended, having just hurled the stone
Glaux watches from behind Hyperbrephos, still holding the red ball
Lukos recoils with wide eyes and an open mouth of surprise
The small gray stone is embedded in Lukos's face, having just struck him
The bright red leather ball remains with the hiding Glaux
The white leather ball lies forgotten on the ground
The large gray boulder waits ominously in the background
